about:
Quality Switch Inc operates from Newton Falls, Ohio. The company's current executive director, Larry Dix, joined in 1995 after a career as an engineer in the transformer industry and redirected the business toward engineering and design alongside manufacturing. The firm has been recognized as a family-owned business by the Regional Chamber.

The company produces de-energized tap changers and electrical switches primarily for transformers and load centers. Its capabilities span engineering, design, and manufacturing, backed by a testing program that includes short-circuit, impulse, applied-voltage, and mechanical-endurance evaluations. A quality management system certified to ISO 9001:2015 is maintained, and several employees hold statistical quality control certifications from Kent State University.

Quality Switch serves the electrical equipment sector, focusing on transformer and load-center manufacturers that require customized switching solutions. The company emphasizes tailored integration of its products into customers' designs.

The company differentiates itself through a commitment to rigorous testing, periodic retesting of designs and materials, and a responsible-sourcing policy for conflict minerals. Its quality program has evolved from ISO 9001:1994 to the current 2015 standard.
